12\. Strong problem\-solving skillsand attention to detail.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Job Software Engineer

Shape the Future of Sustainable Mobility

You are a software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and wants your work to have a visible, real-world impact. You enjoy building robust, scalable software, collaborating with talented engineers, and continuously learning new technologies. Most importantly, you want to contribute to something bigger: accelerating the transition to sustainable transportation.

At Siemens eMobility
, you will develop intelligent charging solutions that power electric trucks, buses, fleets, and public charging networks around the world. Every line of code you write contributes to technology that helps cities, businesses, and communities move toward a cleaner future.

If you're looking for a role where innovation, purpose, and professional growth come together, this opportunity was created for you.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer
, you will play a key role in developing the next generation of EV charging solutions. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you'll contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle—from concept and architecture to implementation, validation, release, and continuous improvement.

You Will

Design & Develop

Create reliable, scalable, and maintainable software for Siemens EV charging solutions.
Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
Develop solutions that perform in demanding real-world operational environments.
Help shape the future evolution of our charging product portfolio.

Drive Quality

Ensure high software quality through automated testing, code reviews, validation activities, and secure development practices.
Contribute to CI/CD improvements and modern engineering methods.
Support the adoption of AI-assisted development and testing where it adds value.

Solve Meaningful Challenges

Analyze and resolve technical issues across products, systems, and development processes.
Identify opportunities for innovation, optimization, and continuous improvement.
Deliver solutions that improve reliability, user experience, and operational performance.

Collaborate Across Disciplines

Work closely with software, systems, hardware, product management, and quality teams.
Align technical priorities and release objectives with stakeholders.
Share knowledge and communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way.

What's in It for You?

Make an Impact – Help accelerate the global energy transition through innovative EV charging technology.
Innovate Every Day – Work with cutting-edge charging infrastructure, modern software practices, and AI-assisted development.
Keep Learning – Benefit from continuous development opportunities and collaboration with experts across Siemens' global network.
Enjoy Flexibility – Thrive in a culture built on trust, ownership, teamwork, and work-life balance.
Join a Great Team – Collaborate with passionate engineers and innovators who support and inspire each other.

What You Bring

We're interested in talented engineers with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you meet most of the requirements below, we'd love to hear from you.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Professional experience in software development using C, C++, C#, Python, or comparable programming languages.
Solid understanding of software architecture, design principles, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
A structured way of working with a quality-focused mindset.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
A proactive attitude, ownership mindset, and passion for continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

Experience with embedded systems.
Knowledge of EV charging infrastructure or energy-related technologies.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools.
Familiarity with cybersecurity principles.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Knowledge of quality improvement methodologies such as RCA, A3, or 8D.

About Siemens EMobility

At Siemens eMobility, we develop reliable and scalable charging solutions that support sustainable mobility worldwide. By combining engineering excellence, digital innovation, and customer focus, we help shape the future of transportation and energy.

Together, we are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of electric mobility.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're excited about building software that powers the future of transportation, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of EV charging with Siemens eMobility.

jobs.title: Real Time Motion Platform Software Designer
jobs.description:
As a Real Time Motion Platform Software Designer, you design and define the software that controls how complex machines or high‑tech systems behave and operate.

In this role, you support our customers in creating and integrating system control software for high-tech equipment in the semiconductor, analytical, medical equipment industry, defence, cleantech and emerging, within the Brainport region and beyond. Your software expertise plays a vital role in bringing high-tech solutions to life, for different operating systems, including state machine and real-time aspects.

What excites you as a Real Time Motion Platform Software Designer?

You will be working on a toolchain that enables the development of highly customizable real-time software applications for advanced motion control. Among its features are high sample frequencies that enable high controller bandwidths, MIMO control, iterative learning control and setpoint shaping. It connects to system behavior layer via a Sioux proprietary communication framework and the sensor/actuator layer via EtherCAT.

As a Real Time Motion Platform Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Eindhoven, and occasionally at our clients’ premises, you enjoy working on:

Translating requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Owning a module or sub-system throughout the entire software development cycle.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of (senior) engineers.

Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

8+ years of experience in software engineering, including software design with Real-Time Linux, MPSoC, ARM, EtherCAT, C++, C#, Python, CI/CD, and Matlab/Simulink
Hands-on, eager to learn, and interested in long-term involvement in the Motion platform team
Actively contributes to the roadmap, strategy, design, and implementation
Strong affinity with real-time systems, with a focus on clean architecture, design, and maintainability
Experienced in platform thinking and capable of guiding (temporary) contributors
Supports projects in system bring-up and infrastructure setup, and enjoys collaboration across different domains
Ambition to grow into senior/architect role (optional)
Valid European driving license, open to work flexible times and willingness to frequently travel abroad;

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to buy an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
Our Sioux office is located in a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. At our main office you can enjoy lunch, sports, making music, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues in one of our Tech Labs.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

Important note:

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Entwicklung cloudbasierter und serviceorientierter Lösungen für den internationalen Einsatz im Industrieversicherungsgeschäft

jobs.title: Software Architekt - Digital Health Excellence Center (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?

Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres international aufgestellten Digital Health Excellence Centers arbeitest du mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern zusammen – und bist gleichzeitig an einem unserer deutschen Standorte in Köln, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Main, Hamburg, München oder Stuttgart verankert. Wir realisieren sowohl internationale Projekte als auch Vorhaben für deutsche Verwaltungen auf Bundes-, Landes- und Kommunalebene und gestalten dabei moderne, sichere Systeme für Millionen von Menschen.

Im Fokus steht dabei die digitale Transformation des Gesundheitswesens – von interoperablen IT-Lösungen bis hin zu innovativen Digital-Health-Strategien. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:

Zielarchitekturen & Referenzarchitekturen definieren (Domänen-/Modul-Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse, Persistenzstrategien) für Web-/Mobile-Healthcare-Projekte
Analyse von Anforderungen und Erstellung technischer Konzepte sowie Modellierungen
Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagern, Scrum Mastern und Entwicklern zur Umsetzung agiler Projekte; Durchführung Code-naher Reviews
Sicherstellung von Interoperabilität und Einhaltung von Standards wie HL7/FHIR, OMOP oder openEHR
Beratung zu Technologie-Trends und deren Anwendung im Gesundheitswesen

Dein Skillset

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, (Software-)Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren IT-nahen Fachgebiet sowie mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon idealerweise 2 Jahre im Healthcare-Umfeld sowie Deutsch- und Englischkentnisse auf C1 Niveau
Tiefes Verständnis von Softwarearchitekturen (Netzwerk, Infrastruktur, Sicherheit, Persistenz, Anwendung, Frontend) sowie Erfahrung mit Datenbankdesign und Modellierung
Kenntnisse in Web- und Mobile-Entwicklung (z. B. Angular, ASP.net, Ruby on Rails, Android/iOS) und gängigen Programmiersprachen (Java, C++, C#, Python, PHP)

Dein Mindset

Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.

Deine Benefits

Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Bewirb dich noch heute!

Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.

Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
insightix is a social services transformation consultancy focused on sustainability, social responsibility, and community empowerment. The company partners with organizations to address complex business and social challenges using cutting-edge technologies and methodologies. By designing transformation initiatives, empowerment programs, and impact measurement services, insightix helps clients achieve measurable, long-term positive change. The team is driven by a vision of pioneering social services consultation and building transformative, resilient futures. Every engagement is aimed at nurturing empowered communities and contributing to a better world.
Role Description
The Senior Software Engineer is a full-time hybrid role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining back-end software solutions that support insightix’s social services transformation, empowerment programs, and impact measurement platforms. Day-to-day tasks include writing clean, scalable code, implementing APIs and data integrations, optimizing system performance, and collaborating with product, data, and consulting teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. The Senior Software Engineer will also review code, mentor less experienced engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure best practices in security, reliability, and maintainability. The role requires active participation in planning sessions, documentation, and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
Proficiency in Software Development and Programming, with experience delivering production-grade systems.
Hands-on expertise in Back-End Web Development, including APIs, microservices, and database design.
Advanced skills in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and designing modular, maintainable architectures.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with modern server-side languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, C#, Python, Node.js) and relational/non-relational databases.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD practices for deployment and automation.
Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate complex concepts clearly, and mentor peers.
Experience building systems related to analytics, impact measurement, or social services domains is an advantage.
Fluency in Arabic; knowledge of English and familiarity with the regional context in Saudi Arabia are beneficial.
